dealbreakers.why: The anomaly marks the CFO's working-capital credit unresolved because 'The contract-asset line ... is not in my inputs'. But the cash-flow statement at 8k_2_02:89 and mdna:98 carries that line, and the reader item it cites points to it. Taken together, the half's working-capital lines absorbed less cash than a year earlier, so the inputs settle the question against the anomaly's title.
The what writes 'seven-year compliance period' in the analyst's own words, outside any quote. It is a figure the filer prints at mdna:76, and no calculator path supplies it.

The MD&A (mdna:110) and the note (notes:211) give the payments different period labels. note_history:2, which the cited note-wording item repeats, gives the first-quarter payments, and adding the second-quarter payments in notes:211 reproduces the note's six-month figures. So the inputs show the MD&A label is the error, yet the anomaly leaves it unresolved.

The disaggregation tables notes:32 and notes:33 give AAON-branded Products totals that match the release's amount and growth rate at 8k_2_02:26, and the mdna:25 figure equals the increase between them. The cited notes item points to notes:32, yet the anomaly says no input can check which amount is right.

ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter is derived as the half less the first quarter. ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter is negative while ratios.growth.net_income.quarter_over_quarter is positive, and 8k_2_02:57 speaks only of the half.
Dealbreaker. With the contract-asset line at 8k_2_02:89 and mdna:98, the half's working-capital changes together absorbed less cash than a year earlier, the opposite of the title.

earnings_versus_cash.smoothness is below one, and its formula note reads 'below 1 means income moves less than cash'. Only quarters-back-1 and quarters-back-5 fill accruals_over_total_assets, as the numbers reader's insufficient item says.

trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue is 'lowest of the 6 filled quarters' and quarters-back-1 is 'highest of the 6 filled quarters'. notes:49 states the revenue recognized from the opening contract-liability balance.

coverage.why: Every accounting area and the industry lens carry a finding and a verdict, and the financial file answers every section plus dupont and path_to_distress. input_manifest.json analysis_stages records '"dropped": 0' for both analysis_accounting and analysis_financial.

calibration.why: Area verdicts track their anomalies. cross_document_reconciliation says 'There is one contradiction (unrestricted cash)' and its only contradicts-coded anomaly is the unrestricted-cash item; cost_deferral calls its points presentational, and its anomalies are non-GAAP and tagging items.

valuation_reading.why: price_position and market_implied_growth read 'Not computed' and most_sensitive reads 'Not ranked'. market.missing, valuation.missing and implied_growth_beside_history.implied_ten_year_revenue_growth.missing leave no price, WACC or reverse DCF to read from.
